turns.input: Brother Aven gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration:
Brother Aven sits on a low stone ledge near Heartstone's main entrance, the leather boots resting across his knees. He lifts them with both hands and extends them toward Nicco. "Take these. You'll want something between you and the streets here."

Nicco accepts the boots.

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration:
Nicco thanks Brother Aven, then holds the boots out toward him. "You'll need them more than me."

Brother Aven looks at the offered boots, then up at Nicco's face with mild, assessing patience. He does not reach for them. "I gave them to you," he says. "I have others." A slight, tired smile touches his mouth. "Keep them, or don't. But I won't take them back."
